items.signal_prefix: AI data-center product pipeline (annual report R&D table): A

set.signal: AI data-center product pipeline (annual report R&D table): APEX VH high-speed backplane connector and Intrepid apex vr cable backplane connector module (for customers' AI racks) are in small-batch trial production, targeting mass-production transfer and bulk customer delivery in Q3 2026; Nexus XH backplane connector module (224G AI racks) targets mass-production transfer and bulk delivery in Q2 2026; OminClip 224G chip-side NPC connector (128 GPU cards per rack) is at sample certification with mass production in Q3 & Q4 2026; Nearstack 2.0 Plug cable connector for an overseas customer's 18G project is at sample certification, mass production Q4 2026 & Q1 2027; OmniX to OSFP targets mass-production transfer in Q3 2026; OSFP224 2X1 high-speed external optical port (TH6 project) targets mass-production transfer in Q3 2026; the FP801 800G OSFP 2xFR4 optical module, developed for a well-known overseas cloud vendor's data center growth, is in small-batch trial, to move into production and generate sales in 2026; the DPA03 1.6T OSFP DR/FR optical module is at the R&D validation-test stage, targeting initial validation in Q4 2025 and product maturity in 2026 with revenue building gradually; a 33KW high-power-density rack power supply is at sample certification with revenue to build gradually in 2026.

items.reason: DPA03 'Q4 2025 initial validation' is in the R&D table's target column (拟达到的目标); its progress column says R&D validation-test stage, so 'completed' overstates it
